certifications_partner.text: ational response to the changing needs of the manufacturing sector which is driven by the need to adopt industry 4.0 technologies and practices in the face of both Brexit and global competition challenges. The centre will also provide training through apprenticeships and traineeships for people who are interested in pursuing careers in the advance manufacturing domain. It is envisaged that the centre will become a focal point for the delivery of upskilling and reskilling opportunities for the manufacturing sector. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. Gewenste kennis • Uitgebreide kennis

er Service, Sales, Omnichannel, Customer Insights – Journeys, Customer Voice en Copilot- functionaliteiten evenals de bijbehorende integratie-, Dataverse- en Power Platform- functionaliteiten. • Architectuur, governance en solution design binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Microsoft Power Platform. • Kennis van softwarearchitectuurprincipes, integratiearchitectuur en solution governance. • Kennis van de andere Microsoft 365-componenten (SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Exchange Online, Teams, …) en de integraties met Microsoft Dynamics 365. • Projectbeheer en projectmanagement: beheren van prestaties, timing, budget, correcte inschattingen kunnen maken en het tijdig rapporteren van knelpunten, risico’s. • Procesanalyse- en modellering: kennis van modellerings- en analysemethodieken. • Kennis van Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Power Platform. • Kennis van Microsoft .NET Framework en moderne .NET-platformen (.NET Core, .NET 6 of hoger) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van programmeertalen (C#, JavaScript, TypeScript) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van Azure-integratiecomponenten zoals Azure Functions, Logic Apps en API Management, evenals REST API's, Microsoft Entra ID en cloudnative integrati

Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. Im Falle der Einleitung eines Nachprüfungsverfahrens vor der Vergabekammer hat die Vergabestelle nach § 163 Abs. 2 S. 4 GWB die Vergabeakten der Kammer sofort zur Verfügung zu stellen. Dies gilt auch für das Verfahren der sofortigen Beschwerde vor dem zuständigen Oberlandesgericht nach § 171 GWB. In diesen Verfahren werden personenbezogene Daten ggf. auch an andere Verfa hrensbeteiligte weitergegeben. Zusätzlich müssen ein Zertifikat und eine Zertifikat-Key-Datei auf den dort angegebenen Verzeichnissen abgelegt werden. 2024 wurde das neue Zertifikat als .pfx Datei geliefert. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

Kostnader ved utarbeidelse av tilbud Eventuelle kostnader leverandøren har ved utarbeidelse av tilbudet dekkes av leverandøren selv. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Leverandøren kan bli bedt om å levere en sladdet versjon av tilbudet dersom det fremsettes innsynskrav. Behandling av personopplysninger Personopplysninger som inngår i tilbudet behandles av oppdragsgiver for å gjennomføre anskaffelsen, evaluere tilbud og følge opp kontrakt. Behandlingen skjer i tråd med personvernregelverket. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for at personopplysninger i tilbudet er lovlig innhentet og nødvendige for tilbudet. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Hij/zij evalueert problemen inzake informatieveiligheid, stelt veiligheidsbeleidslijnen op en brengt adviezen uit. Hij/zij verricht conformiteitsassessments t.o.v. het veiligheidsbeleid en wettelijke verplichtingen. Deze kunnen een operationeel, tactisch en strategisch karakter hebben. Hij/zij begeleidt veranderingsprocessen op organisatorisch, technisch en procesniveau. Hij/zij werkt op basis van risico-inschatting en risicoanalyse. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory
